headline: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades Sri Lanka Sovereign Credit Rating to B-
summary: S&P Global Ratings raised Sri Lanka’s foreign currency and local currency sovereign credit ratings to B-.
why: Sovereign credit rating upgrades lower borrowing costs for governments and improve access to international capital markets.

impacts.name: Sri Lanka
impacts.why: An upgrade in foreign and local currency sovereign ratings reduces perceived default risk and borrowing costs.
